name: BUSTED_S

args.name: submodel
args.description: The model as a function of dN/dS

args.name: omegaDist
args.description: The distribution of conserved omega (dN/dS) values and their mixture weights

args.name: posP
args.description: The branch-site mixture weight of the positive-selection category

args.name: posW
args.description: The omega value for the positive-selection category under the alternative

args.name: posSelection
args.description: The model selector: 1 if positive selection, 0 if not

args.name: alpha
args.description: The shape parameter for the Gamma distribution

args.name: nGammaBins
args.description: The number of bins for discretizing the Gamma distribution

args.name: n
args.description: The number of categories in the default conserved omega distribution

description:
A Bayesian BUSTED-S variant for testing positive selection, with Gamma-distributed rate variation across sites. Omega (dN/dS) categories vary among branches and sites, while each site has a Gamma rate category shared across the tree. All branches participate in the test.

The omega mixture combines conserved categories with a positive-selection category of weight posP. This category has omega=posW under the alternative (posSelection=1) and omega=1 under the null (posSelection=0).

The posterior probability of positive selection concerns the overall model comparison, not individual sites. Average PrPosSelection to estimate the posterior probability of positive selection; it can give a more accurate estimate than averaging posSelection. Use statreport to summarize LogOddsPosSelection; do not average that field directly.

citation.title: Synonymous Site-to-Site Substitution Rate Variation Dramatically Inflates False Positive Rates of Selection Analyses: Ignore at Your Own Peril
